resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register says nothing remains; a 2008 trip report describes collapsed tower remains and one usable platform on the summit. Both are reported. The current state of the summit is unconfirmed.
The register calls the lookout a ground cabin; the 2008 trip report describes the summit remains as a lookout tower.

notes_for_editor: The register and the 2008 trip report disagree on what remains, so the story reports both. The trip report is a personal account, not an official survey, and it is dated October 6, 2008. The 1917 storm report comes from a weebly transcription of a Bakersfield Californian item, not the original paper. A search snippet that named Sequoia National Forest for Kern Peak was not fetched and is not used; the register and the weebly page both say Inyo. No Forest Service record was found.
